What is Hoshi?

Every child is a star, and every star shines in its own way.

A modern home schooling platform where every child learns at their own pace, with their own teacher.

Read more

Why Hoshi?

What problem does Hoshi solve?

Rote learning, exam stress and no time for creative or digital skills.

Why does my child need it?

One classroom pace can't fit every child. Hoshi plans around yours.

What do parents get?

A weekly plan, progress updates and a personal mentor.

What is the vision?

Curious, confident children who think for themselves.

Why not traditional learning?

More attention, more skills, flexible timings, your language.

How we are different

Your child gets a teacher's full attention

In a classroom, one teacher shares their time with 30 children. At Hoshi, every lesson is planned and taught for your child alone.

Book a free demo for your child
  • Personalised learning: a plan built around your child's level, pace and interests.
  • Individual attention: no waiting and no hiding at the back. Doubts are cleared the moment they come up.
  • Academics plus creativity: school subjects alongside music, art, abacus and AI skills.
  • Flexible timings at home: lessons fit your family's routine.
  • Parents stay involved: clear weekly updates and a mentor you can talk to.
  • Multilingual learning: teaching in English, Hindi or Gujarati, with French, Spanish and Japanese as subjects.
